overviewParagraphs: Ballyshear Golf Links is Bangkok's most intellectually serious golf offering — a course built for players who understand and appreciate golf history. The design is a faithful contemporary recreation of C.B. Macdonald's legendary Lido Golf Club (1914), a Long Island layout considered among the finest classical designs ever created, and destroyed decades ago by development. Ballyshear resurrects it in Southeast Asia for a new generation of golfers.

Macdonald's design philosophy — wide corridors, multiple strategic approaches, ground game emphasis, and template holes derived from the greatest holes in golf history — is preserved faithfully throughout. Playing Ballyshear demands a different mental approach from the typical resort experience: bump-and-run, links creativity, and strategic positioning matter far more than conventional shot selection.

For discerning golfers with a deep love of classical golf architecture and a desire for something genuinely unique in Thailand's golf landscape, AGS regards Ballyshear as an extraordinary discovery. It sits in an entirely different cultural category from the resort courses that dominate the market — and that is precisely its value.

curatorBriefHtml: Ballyshear Golf Links is a premier Par 71 championship layout in Bangkok, Thailand, crafted by Gil Hanse (2021) and stretching to 6,152 Yards (Blue Tees) across a flat links terrain, wide fairways environment. In Asia Golf Specialists' (AGS) field evaluations, the course stands out for its historic template holes (redan, biarritz, eden) (Tribute to Macdonald & Raynor) and firm running fast links style (Ground game architecture).

From an itinerary-engineering perspective, Ballyshear Golf Links (Resort & Visitor Access via AGS) requires advance flight allocation and experienced local caddie pairing—particularly during the peak Thailand dry season. Our curatorial scorecard specifically notes its caddie template knowledge (Crucial on deep swales), making pre-reserved morning tee times and private door-to-clubhouse VIP transfers essential for maintaining pace of play.

When integrated into a multi-round Bangkok golf tour by AGS, Ballyshear Golf Links provides a distinct architectural test by Gil Hanse that complements neighboring regional layouts while keeping daily hotel-to-tee transfer times streamlined.

scorecard.gradeBadge: Gil Hanse Vintage Template Masterpiece • Bangkok
scorecard.verdict: Designed by Gil Hanse as an homage to C.B. Macdonald's legendary Lido Club. A thrilling strategic revival featuring authentic Golden Age template holes like the Biarritz, Redan, and Punchbowl.

faqs.q: What are the key course specifications for Ballyshear Golf Links?
faqs.a: Ballyshear Golf Links in Bangkok, Thailand is a Par 71 championship layout designed by Gil Hanse (opened 2021), measuring 6,152 Yards (Blue Tees) within a flat links terrain, wide fairways setting. It is particularly noted for historic template holes (redan, biarritz, eden) (Tribute to Macdonald & Raynor).

faqs.q: How do I secure tee times and caddies at Ballyshear Golf Links?
faqs.a: Ballyshear Golf Links operates under resort & visitor access via ags protocols. Asia Golf Specialists secures guaranteed morning tee times, compulsory caddie and cart pairings (caddie template knowledge (Crucial on deep swales)), and private VIP transfers from your Bangkok hotel as part of a custom golf itinerary.

faqs.q: What playing conditions and turf can golfers expect at Ballyshear Golf Links?
faqs.a: Our field inspection highlights Ballyshear Golf Links's firm running fast links style (Ground game architecture) alongside historic template holes (redan, biarritz, eden) (Tribute to Macdonald & Raynor). Standard championship golf attire (collared shirts, tailored trousers or shorts, and soft-spike golf shoes) is strictly enforced by the starter.
